about: Known-correct substantive checks for Vespera Grid Storage (reconciles-coupled-ledger): coupled 4-variable ratio optimization, 4-constraint integer infeasibility, multi-hop counterfactual ownership, and source integrity.

checks.check: Every quote is in its source's saved text
Every figure recorded is written in the words quoted
Every source in the corpus was read and recorded
Every statement recorded is read by an answer rule
GridPulse Blog misquotes the 10-K Services floor as $80M instead of $50M
Helios's 18% direct stake (or Nordic's 35% / 60% stake) is corroborated independently by two publishers
An assumption or violation check flags the covenant failure or site infeasibility
Every text and query of the page runs
The page reports the exact minimum gross margin 27.83%
The page reports the exact maximum gross margin 33.33%
The report concludes Vespera does NOT provably clear the 28.0% covenant
The report gives the exact minimum gross margin 27.83%
The report gives the exact maximum gross margin 33.33% (not the naive 33.23% at R=520)
The report gives the exact min witness (g=290, m=140, s=50, f=30)
The report gives the exact max witness (g=240, m=145, s=95, f=24)
The report proves the modular site constraints are impossible (requiring at least 44 sites vs cap 43)
The report computes Helios effective stake as 51% with Apex SPV and 39% (below 50%) when the tertiary blog claim is retracted
The report flags the $20M fixed-overhead restatement and GridPulse's $80M vs $50M misquote
